name: multi_merge_consolidator
description: Starts with k=7 and asks to consolidate four clusters into one in a single turn. Forces the system to emit a SINGLE merge op with ≥3 cluster_ids (the f_output prompt explicitly warns against chaining merges). Also stresses K-arithmetic.
goal: Inspect the 7 initial clusters. Identify four that overlap on topic / sentiment / angle and ask, in one message, to merge ALL FOUR into a single cluster with a specific name you propose in quotes. After it lands, ask to merge two more redundant clusters together. Declare satisfied once the structure is down to ~3 coherent clusters.

notes.tone: decisive, consolidation-minded — uses words like 'collapse', 'fold these together'
notes.extra: When asking to consolidate four clusters, name all four explicitly in raw_text ('merge cluster 1, 2, 4 and 6 into "X"'). Do NOT issue them as separate requests across turns — the point is to push the planner into a single merge op with 4 cluster_ids. Never ask for splits or re-embeds.
